SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Decomposers only
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Tertiary consumers
   D. Producers

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sound Energy? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sound Energy.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sound Energy.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sound Energy.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Sound Energy.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number of lessons 120 NOTE: The sugg? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number of lessons 120 NOTE: The sugg.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number of lessons 120 NOTE: The sugg.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number of lessons 120 NOTE: The sugg.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number of lessons 120 NOTE: The sugg.

6. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water always increases oxygen

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Pollution? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Pollution.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Water Pollution.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Pollution.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Pollution.

8. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only carbon dioxide

9. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 100 °C
   D. 37 °C

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Classification of Plants? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Classification of Plants.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Classification of Plants.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Classification of Plants.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Classification of Plants.

11. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying The Human Breathing System? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about The Human Breathing System.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on The Human Breathing System.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Human Breathing System.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to The Human Breathing System.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain The Human Breathing system 18 2.0. Matter 2.1. Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Mixtures 14 2.2. Water Pollution 18 3.0. Force and Energy 3.1. Floating and Sink and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Mixtures and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Water Pollution and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

5. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Sound Energy 14 3.3. Heat transfer 12 Total number of lessons 120 NOTE: The sugg.

6. A — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

7. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Pollution.

8. A — Glucose and oxygen

9. C — 100 °C

10. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Classification of Plants.

11. C — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio

12. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for The Human Breathing System.
